I don’t have real-time access to current weather data or your location. To find out the weather today, I recommend checking a trusted weather service like:

- Your device’s built-in weather app  
- Websites like [weather.com](https://www.weather.com), [AccuWeather](https://www.accuweather.com), or [Windy](https://www.windy.com)  
- Voice assistants (e.g., “Hey Siri, what’s the weather?” or “Alexa, what’s the weather today?”)

If you tell me your city or general location (e.g., “New York City” or “Tokyo”), I can help interpret a weather forecast or explain terms like “feels like,” humidity, or UV index! ☀️🌧️🌤️
